quarterly_data.signal: CEO Dara Khosrowshahi gave the AV partner count and the next milestones: Uber is operating now in markets with nine partners and thinks it will get to 15 by the end of the year. Next year Uber will demonstrate no vehicle operator partnerships with a number of players in the U.S. - next year is about establishing the technical capability to go NVO - and then 2028, 2029 is all about scaling. Named partners include Waymo, Zoox, WeRide (a top partner outside the U.S. that Uber has invested in, with a partnership just announced in Madrid), Pony.ai and Avride.
quarterly_data.figure: nine partners today, 15 by the end of the year; NVO demonstrations next year; 2028, 2029 for scaling

quarterly_data.signal: AV hardware cost curve: Uber has a number of partners that have clear line of sight to a $50,000, $60,000 cost as it relates to these AVs, including compute, including sensors. Uber has secured access to over 120,000 vehicles and expects to keep increasing that; the second investment lane is working with OEMs and manufacturers so Uber has access to vehicles that are AV ready with redundancy, compute and sensor stacks. Management expects vehicle financing to develop through finance partners the same way data center financing has.
quarterly_data.figure: clear line of sight to a $50,000, $60,000 cost including compute and sensors; access secured to over 120,000 vehicles

quarterly_data.signal: Unit-economics argument for the network model: AV economics shift from a high variable cost model (paying drivers per trip) to a high fixed cost model, so vehicle and depot utilization drive the returns. Because Uber already has the demand and liquidity, it estimates it can drive utilization about 30% higher than a 1P player would achieve, and that 30% utilization advantage applies against both the fixed AV cost and the fixed infrastructure cost. Uber's third AV investment lane is fleet management, depots and infrastructure for repair and recharging, where multiple partners can share a single depot, and it runs a hybrid fleet with a base load of AVs plus human drivers for peaks.
quarterly_data.figure: utilization advantage estimated at 30% versus a 1P player
